title: CrossNode-Bench: claim-vs-truth evidence for AI agents

creators.name: Šuster, Renato
creators.affiliation: GAMA TRADE d.o.o. / gamAI, Usora, Bosnia and Herzegovina

creators.name: Jeftić, Boško
creators.affiliation: City Administration of Zenica; University of Vitez

description:
v1.6.3 (2026-11-24): documentation release accompanying manuscript v1.2. No data file changes, so all data digests from v1.6.2 still hold. Replaces the per-run README with an English data description (run table with a gated column, per-case table, mapping to the numbers used in the paper), adds LICENSES_AND_OUTPUTS.md (model licences, prompt provenance, absence of personal data) and withdraws the internal notes that earlier versions carried in lumi/raw/README.md.

CrossNode-Bench measures whether an AI agent tells the truth about completed work. For each task the harness records the agent's claim, an independent probe on the target node, and a verdict; claim success plus truth failure is a false success.

v1.6 summary, as reported in manuscript v1.2 (all counts reproducible with recount.py): Vultr honest fleet 25,600 records, 9 nodes, 0 false successes. Vultr controlled liar 28,800 records, 400 planted false successes, all flagged (MockLiar component; a detection test, not a field rate). Controlled cross-node run 25,600 records with 1,600 false successes; sibling run 19,200 with 1,200. LUMI-G campaign 101,140 records over 24 run ids: 30,798 gated records with 0 false successes and 70,342 unguarded with 5,696. The gate is assigned by case type within a run, so the manuscript also reports a case-level comparison: the five gated case types give 5,495 false successes in 11,353 ungated records and none in 30,798 gated records, and a matched pair of 10,000-record runs on the same model and day with identical prompt hashes gives 1,683 against 0. That comparison is quasi-experimental; no effect size is claimed.

The 12,344-record chained set (SHA-256 chain, Merkle root eda02d9cd4ff14d594d144c2d319bb3a3d1ea16569638238be14779da3d11d2d, offline verifier) is used for integrity verification only. No percentage is reported over it: all 53 false successes in that set lie inside the 918 probe records, so any ratio computed over the full 12,344 would mix probes and non-probes.

Earlier figures that are no longer used: financial "36,550 requests under the gate, 0 false successes" (not reproducible from the per-record harness.guard flags) and "0/10,000 under the gate" (the two 10,000-record runs with zero false successes contain 4,167 gated records each, so their zero applies to the whole run).

Contents: spec v1.2.2, LUMI-G per-request campaign, controlled cross-node runs, Vultr fleet runs, chained evidence with Merkle root, offline verifier, JSON schemas, OPA gate, keyless cosign + in-toto CI workflow, LICENSES_AND_OUTPUTS.md, per-run/per-case README.

What this deposit does not claim: no field false-success rate from controlled tests, no hardware root of trust, no Sigstore public transparency anchor, no peer review.

Aggregate-only material in this deposit (no per-record files): the 6,900-item generated prompt-injection corpus and the 50-task x 6-model audit. They are not part of the quantitative findings of the manuscript.
notes: Manuscript v1.2 accompanies this artifact. Concept DOI of the artifact series: 10.5281/zenodo.23920505. Recount: python3 recount.py --honest … --liar … --trust … --trust2 … --lumi … prints every number in the manuscript. Chained artifact: evidence_chained.jsonl + manifest.json, merkle root eda02d9cd4ff14d594d144c2d319bb3a3d1ea16569638238be14779da3d11d2d.
